column1: # TITLE: Molecular classification of histological origin of NSCLC
# SUMMARY: Lung cancer is one of the most common malignant tumors in the world. The latest edition of WHO classifies lung cancer on the basis of histological morphology and molecular typing
column2: which is a relatively complete pathological classification of lung cancer at present. However
column4: it is difficult to make accurate subtype classification of NSCLC only by using morphological structure and immunohistochemical characteristics
column5: and the degree of coincidence with gene mutation and clinicopathological parameters is poor
column6: which has limited guiding effect on clinical diagnosis and treatment. In this study
column7: we proposed Molecular Pathological Classification Model of NSCLC Tissue Origin.
